verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents use of its MCP tools with popular AI frameworks, including a dedicated Vercel AI SDK guide with code and a sample chat app. It also lists a native MCP connector through Claude's Messages API, covering the Anthropic SDK. Missing for 10: documented adapters for LangChain and CrewAI, explicit confirmation of an OpenAI SDK integration (the 'automatic tool execution' entry is not attributed to a framework), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug the platform's tools into major agent frameworks and SDKs (Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs) with documented adapters
